name: National Assembly of Tanzania (Bunge)
notes: The Bunge's own member list (parliament.go.tz, from the Bunge's POLIS database) held 400 members on 2026-11-11: 270 elected for constituencies, 116 women's special seats, 8 nominated by the President, 5 from the Zanzibar House of Representatives and the Attorney General ex officio. By party: CCM 386, ACT-Wazalendo 9, CHAUMMA 3, NCCR-Mageuzi 1 (a presidential nominee). The list does not show vacant seats, so the 400 is the count of sitting members, not the constitutional maximum (a published figure was not found). CHADEMA was barred from the October 2025 election and holds no seat. No supporter sits.
